build_PISARetinaHead: build a PISA RetinaNet head model that extends RetinaHead with ISR-P and CARL loss
review_PISARetinaHead_loss_by_feat: review the PISARetinaHead loss_by_feat method that computes classification, regression, and CARL losses
test_PISARetinaHead_loss_by_feat: test the PISARetinaHead loss_by_feat method with cls_scores, bbox_preds, and batch_gt_instances
refactor_PISARetinaHead_ISR_P: refactor the PISARetinaHead ISR-P reweighting logic to apply importance-based sample reweighting for positive samples
summarize_PISARetinaHead_CARL: summarize the PISARetinaHead CARL loss computation that adds classification-aware regression loss to training
